newsitem.title: CANADA: Legacy Storage to focus on tape data.
newsitem.headline: Legacy Storage to focus on tape data.

text.p: Legacy Storage Systems International Inc said its board of directors has decided to restructure the company's operations to focus on the tape data storage business through its unit, Tecmar Technologies Inc.
Legacy said it will divest itself of its systems business, but gather any proprietary technology under Tecmar.
Legacy chief executive officer president Keith Leno has resigned and chief financial officer Robert McQuade has left the board of directors as a result of the restructuring.
